o: Who will save the world? Drag Queens! RuPaul brings together eight of her most powerful All Stars to slay it forward in the name of charity. All season long, the queens will battle as they raise thousands of dollars for their favorite causes. But in the end, only one will win a coveted spot in the prestigious Drag Race Hall of Fame.

v.n: RuPaul's Drag Race All Stars 9 | Trailer
Meet The Queens of All Stars 9 | RuPaul’s Drag Race

eps.o: Eight All Stars return to compete to win $200,000 for their favorite charity, and a spot in the Drag Race Hall of Fame. They serve up an epic performance of the anthem "Drag Queens Save the World," and Keke Palmer joins for this gagworthy premiere.

The Queens present a total of 24 iconic looks on the runway - including hand-painted masterpieces created in the Werk Room - in the art-inspired Paint Ball. Oscar-nominated actor Stephanie Hsu joins the judges' panel to appraise the Queens' work.

Romance is in the air as the Queens impersonate celebrities in the Snatch Game of Love. But when two All Stars want to play the same celeb, things get spicy! Meanwhile, a twist means that more badges are up for grabs! Pop superstar Anitta stops by.

This week begins with fiery accusations, and when the Queens are tasked with transforming four sexy firefighters into hot pop stars, things really start to sizzle! Country music duo the Brothers Osborne join the judges panel and feel the heat.

This week our All Stars' put their sales skills to the test, as they create raucous real estate commercials for some preposterous properties. Superstar Realtor Tracy Tutor and Comedian Alec Mapa stop by to assess what's on the market.

While the ruby snippers cause icy vibes in the workroom, it’s hotter than an oven on the main stage, as the queens roast each other to a crisp. Television icon Ruta Lee joins the panel to witness the hilarious jabs.

This week, the All-Stars get slap happy as they costar with RuPaul in an acting challenge inspired by some of cinema’s most classic catfights. Foxy actor Colton Haynes joins the judging panel to take in all the drama!

eps.t: Make Your Own Kind Of Rusic
eps.o: After hard feelings rock the workroom, Mama Ru challenges the dolls to create chart-topping looks inspired by her hit songs. Fashion icon Jeremy Scott joins the judge panel to decide which looks are bops and which are flops!
This week, the All Stars dance with the devil in a spooky-ooky Rusical that leaves the judges shook! Dance music legend Kristine W joins the panel for a twisted good time.

The competition is closer than ever, so when Ru announces that the Queens must Lip Sync for their badges this week, the All Stars go into Assassin mode to slay the stage! Who will be the last Queen standing?
This week, Mama Ru drops a gag-worthy twist on the All-Stars... Before their final challenge of the season, the queens must cast a game-changing vote - and it's anybody’s crown to win!

It's the crowning moment of the two-part Grand Finale, and all the Queens hit the stage for an unforgettable Variety Extravaganza! Three badges are up for grabs, and a new voting twist could change everything! In the end, only one queen can win.
